blocks.orig: Close to Seronera airstrip, in Serengeti National Park, you find Golden Safari Camp among acacia trees. This solar-powered camp offers several en-suite safari tents with fluffy beds, hot showers, and flush toilets. A family tent with two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a central living area is available for groups of up to 4 people. The camp features a restaurant tent that serves a variety of continental and local cuisine. Additional amenities include a communal lounge area, a fireplace (bonfire) for evening gatherings, and a Wi-Fi internet hotspot in the main tent.
blocks.html: Set among acacia trees near the Seronera airstrip in Serengeti National Park lies Golden Safari Camp. The camp runs on solar power and has several en-suite safari tents with soft beds, hot showers and flush toilets. For groups of up to 4 people there is a family tent with two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a central living area. In the restaurant tent you can choose from a range of continental and local dishes. Other facilities are a shared lounge area, a fireplace (bonfire) for get-togethers in the evening and a Wi-Fi internet hotspot in the main tent.
